articles.title: Private security firms will soon be allowed to hack overseas cybercriminals
articles.content: Trump memo is first time gov't has authorized private sector to perform cyberattacks.
articles.titleZh: 私营安全公司很快将被允许入侵海外网络犯罪分子
articles.contentZh: 特朗普备忘录是政府首次没有授权私营部门进行网络攻击。

articles.title: Terabytes of credentials leaked in massive supply-chain attack
articles.content: The data was scraped and exfiltrated from 2,500 users of a compromised AI package.
articles.titleZh: 在大规模供应链攻击中泄露了数TB的凭据
articles.contentZh: 这些数据是从受感染的人工智能软件包的2500名用户那里刮取和窃取的。

articles.title: DEF CON crowd suspected in fake-hotspot attack on Delta flight
articles.content: FBI Atlanta confirms it's looking into the incident, no arrests made.
articles.titleZh: DEF CON人群涉嫌对达美航空航班进行假热点攻击
articles.contentZh: 亚特兰大联邦调查局确认正在调查此事件，但没有逮捕任何人。

articles.title: Chrome adopts what may be the best protection yet against account takeovers
articles.content: Device-bound session credentials thwart an increasingly common form of account takeover.
articles.titleZh: Chrome浏览器采用了迄今为止防止账号被盗用的最佳保护措施
articles.contentZh: 设备绑定会话凭据阻止了一种越来越常见的帐户接管形式。

articles.title: Apple and Epic argue over how much Apple should get from purchases made outside the App Store
articles.content: In a new filing in its long-running legal dispute with Epic Games, Apple has proposed a structure that would allow it to collect fees on digital purchases made via external links that don't use the company's in-app purchase system. Epic has already responded, saying that Apple's request is "far outside of the bounds" of the […]
